summary: Implement Task 076a inside the frozen shared-types architecture: exact Money and Decimal/Quantity values, UTC and explicit DST-edge resolution, canonical locale/address boundaries, and provider-neutral currency/tax formatting ports without creating a new domain pillar.

impacts.evidence: The primitive types contain no tenant state, repository, or RLS behavior; tenant scoping remains owned by domain records and storage adapters.
Address is explicitly modeled as structured domain data and kept separate from localized display text; Task 060 classification/redaction still governs any personal address payload.
Six canonical Draft 2020-12 schemas define future Money, Quantity, UTC, locale/timezone, Address, and TaxTreatment wire shapes before commerce APIs are implemented.
Future event payloads must reuse exact decimal strings, integer minor-unit Money, and canonical UTC Z timestamps rather than provider-local numeric/time representations.
Provider adapters will map local currency/unit/address/tax representations to shared primitives; no provider-specific identifier or rule is added to the shared package.
Stage 076a introduces no persistence schema. Task 076b will audit Tasks 004-006 migrations for exact numeric/minor-unit and UTC storage.
Strict decoding/validation rejects float money, non-canonical currencies/locales, machine-local timezone identities, invalid address shapes, and implicit tax representations at shared boundaries.
No approval or transaction-risk policy changes; Task 017 continues to govern sensitive action authorization.
Exact currency, quantity, UTC, and explicit tax values provide deterministic facts that later audit/lineage records can reference without float or timezone ambiguity.
Canonical exact representations eliminate float drift and local-time ambiguity that could otherwise create false reconciliation differences or unstable idempotency material.
Future webhook schemas must emit the canonical domain wire forms, especially decimal strings and UTC Z instants, rather than localized values.
No metrics/logging implementation changes are introduced; presentation formatting remains outside observability fields.
There is no data migration or runtime service state in stage 076a, so rollback is source/contract rollback only subject to normal compatibility policy.

Unit tests cover exact arithmetic, overflow, canonical JSON, Amsterdam DST gap/fold behavior, locale/address validation and explicit tax constraints; schema fixtures include negative float and non-UTC cases.
